# Lungrin's Lawncare

> Locally owned and owner-operated lawn care, rolled longleaf pine straw & mulch installation, fall & winter leaf removal, flowerbed cleanups, shrub & privacy tree planting, bush & hedge trimming, pond/lake shoreline clearing, fence line clearing, bush hogging, and trailer junk/debris hauling based in Flora, Mississippi — serving Flora, Pocahontas, Madison (Annandale & Reunion), Gluckstadt, Ridgeland, North Jackson, Bentonia, and Yazoo County.

## Year-Round & Seasonal Services
- **[Rolled Longleaf Pine Straw & Mulch Installation](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/pine-straw-mulch-installation/):** Peak fall, winter & spring service — complete flowerbed weeding, spaded trench borders, thick longleaf pine straw or hardwood mulch coverage, and tightly hand-tucked rolled fronts.
- **[Fall & Winter Leaf Removal & Yard Cleanups](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/leaf-removal-winter-yard-cleanup/):** Nov–Feb oak leaf, sweetgum, and winter pine-needle clearing with full trailer haul-away.
- **[Pond Bank, Fence-Line Clearing & Bush Hogging](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/pond-bank-fence-line-bush-hogging/):** Peak winter dormant brush clearing & year-round 360-degree pond/lake shoreline reclamation, vine-choked privacy fence clearing, and bush hogging + finish mowing.
- **[Yard Debris, Brush & Trailer Junk Removal](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/junk-removal-yard-debris-hauling/):** Cut limb piles, storm branches, old timber raised-bed excavation, and exterior property cleanouts.
- **[Flowerbed Cleanups, Shrub & Privacy Tree Planting](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/flowerbed-cleanup-shrub-tree-planting/):** Overgrown bed root weeding, dead shrub removal, sod stripping for new curved beds, and evergreen living-privacy-fence tree planting.
- **[Bush, Hedge & Ornamental Shrub Trimming](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/bush-hedge-trimming/):** Late-winter structural rejuvenation pruning, spring/fall sculpting, and 100% clipping haul-off.
- **[Residential Lawn Mowing, 90° Edging & Striping](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/lawn-mowing-edging-striping/):** Weekly & bi-weekly commercial zero-turn turf striping, string trimming, vertical steel-blade concrete edging, and spotless driveway blow-off.
- **[Acreage Mowing & Overgrown Yard Recovery](https://lungrinslawncare.com/services/acreage-mowing-overgrowth-recovery/):** Wide-deck 1–10+ acre estate mowing and multi-stage neglected lawn reclamation.
